message.content:
I’m sorry, but I don’t have real‑time data on the current air quality in Los Angeles. For the most up‑to‑date information you can check:

* **AirNow** (https://www.airnow.gov) – provides hourly AQI values for U.S. cities, including Los Angeles.
* **AQICN** (https://aqicn.org/city/los-angeles/) – offers live maps and historical trends.
* Local news outlets often report on smog alerts when AQI levels rise.

If you’re looking for a quick snapshot, you can also search “Los Angeles AQI” in your browser or use a weather app that includes air‑quality metrics.
